WITH industry_orders AS (
  SELECT
    item.`Sales Document Number`,
    item.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    item.`Measure Net Value in Euro` AS order_value_eur,
    item.`Measure Sales Order Quantity` AS order_qty,
    item.`Delivery Date To Key`,
    COALESCE(csm.`cs_team`, 'Unmapped') AS cs_team,
    item.`Order Status` AS order_status
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` item
      JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg
        ON sorg.`Sales Organization Key` = item.`Sales Organization Key`
      LEFT JOIN `supply_chain_sandbox_d`.`datamodel`.`cs_team_sales_org_mapping` csm
        ON sorg.`Sales_Organization ID` = csm.`sales_org_code`
  WHERE
    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'
    AND (
      item.`Rejection Status` != 'C'
      OR item.`Rejection Status` IS NULL
    )
    AND (
      item.`Sales Document Type Description` IN (
        'Standard Order', 'Rush Order', 'Consignment Issue'
      )
      OR item.`Sales Document Type` IN ('YOR', 'YSO', 'YKE', 'YKB')
    )
    AND item.`Created On` >= 20260101
    ),
all_confirmed_sl_raw AS (
  SELECT
    sl.`Sales Document Number`,
    sl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    TO_DATE(CAST(sl.`Goods Issue Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS gi_date,
    sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` AS confirmed_qty,
    sl.`Measure Order Quantity` AS sl_oq
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_schedule_line` sl
      INNER JOIN industry_orders io
        ON sl.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND sl.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` > 0
    AND sl.`Goods Issue Date`
      >= 20260101
),
-- Dedup: if item has confirmed lines with order_qty > 0,
-- drop confirmed lines with order_qty = 0 (old rescheduled)
all_confirmed_sl AS (
  SELECT `Sales Document Number`, `Sales Document Item Number`, gi_date, confirmed_qty
  FROM (
    SELECT r.*,
      MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl_oq > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (PARTITION BY r.`Sales Document Number`, r.`Sales Document Item Number`) AS has_oq
    FROM all_confirmed_sl_raw r
  )
  WHERE sl_oq > 0 OR has_oq = 0
),
all_unconfirmed_sl AS (
  SELECT
    sl.`Sales Document Number`,
    sl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    TO_DATE(CAST(sl.`Goods Issue Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS gi_date,
    sl.`Measure Order Quantity` AS sl_order_qty
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_schedule_line` sl
      INNER JOIN industry_orders io
        ON sl.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND sl.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` = 0
    AND sl.`Measure Order Quantity` > 0
    AND sl.`Goods Issue Date`
      >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE()), 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)
),
item_confirmed_total AS (
  SELECT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(confirmed_qty) AS total_confirmed
  FROM
    all_confirmed_sl
  GROUP BY
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
),
item_unconfirmed_total AS (
  SELECT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(sl_order_qty) AS total_unconfirmed
  FROM
    all_unconfirmed_sl
  GROUP BY
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
),
items_with_any_sl AS (
  SELECT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
  FROM
    all_confirmed_sl
  WHERE
    gi_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())
  UNION
  SELECT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
  FROM
    all_unconfirmed_sl
),
-- Rule 1a: confirmed schedule lines (full history for FIFO, tag CM vs non-CM)
rule1a AS (
  SELECT
    s.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    CASE
      WHEN
        ict.total_confirmed >= io.order_qty
        OR io.order_qty = 0
      THEN
        io.order_value_eur * (s.confirmed_qty / ict.total_confirmed)
      ELSE io.order_value_eur * (s.confirmed_qty / GREATEST(io.order_qty, ict.total_confirmed))
    END AS allocated_value,
    io.order_qty,
    io.`Sales Document Number`,
    io.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    io.cs_team,
    s.confirmed_qty AS line_qty,
    CASE
      WHEN s.gi_date BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE()) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_cm,
    io.order_status
  FROM
    industry_orders io
      JOIN item_confirmed_total ict
        ON ict.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ict.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN all_confirmed_sl s
        ON s.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND s.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
-- Rule 1b partial: unconfirmed CM SLs for partially-confirmed items
rule1b_partial AS (
  SELECT
    s.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    io.order_value_eur
      * (1.0 - LEAST(ict.total_confirmed / GREATEST(io.order_qty, 1), 1.0))
      * (s.sl_order_qty / iut.total_unconfirmed) AS allocated_value,
    io.order_qty,
    io.`Sales Document Number`,
    io.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    io.cs_team,
    s.sl_order_qty AS line_qty,
    1 AS is_cm,
    io.order_status
  FROM
    industry_orders io
      JOIN item_confirmed_total ict
        ON ict.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ict.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN item_unconfirmed_total iut
        ON iut.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND iut.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN all_unconfirmed_sl s
        ON s.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND s.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    ict.total_confirmed < io.order_qty
    AND io.order_qty > 0
    AND s.gi_date BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE())
),
-- Rule 1b full: unconfirmed CM SLs for fully unconfirmed items
rule1b_full AS (
  SELECT
    s.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    io.order_value_eur * (s.sl_order_qty / iut.total_unconfirmed) AS allocated_value,
    io.order_qty,
    io.`Sales Document Number`,
    io.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    io.cs_team,
    s.sl_order_qty AS line_qty,
    1 AS is_cm,
    io.order_status
  FROM
    industry_orders io
      LEFT JOIN item_confirmed_total ict
        ON ict.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ict.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN item_unconfirmed_total iut
        ON iut.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND iut.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN all_unconfirmed_sl s
        ON s.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND s.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    ict.`Sales Document Number` IS NULL
    AND s.gi_date BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE())
),
-- Rule 2: no schedule lines at all — use delivery date dimension (CM only)
rule2 AS (
  SELECT
    dd.dim_date AS delivery_date,
    io.order_value_eur AS allocated_value,
    io.order_qty,
    io.`Sales Document Number`,
    io.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    io.cs_team,
    io.order_qty AS line_qty,
    1 AS is_cm,
    io.order_status
  FROM
    industry_orders io
      LEFT JOIN items_with_any_sl isl
        ON isl.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND isl.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN (
        SELECT
          `Date Delivery Key`,
          `Date Delivery` AS dim_date
        FROM
          `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_date_delivery`
      ) dd
        ON dd.`Date Delivery Key` = io.`Delivery Date To Key`
  WHERE
    isl.`Sales Document Number` IS NULL
    AND dd.dim_date BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE())
),
all_alloc AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1b_partial
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1b_full
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule2
),
orders_in_scope AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
  FROM
    all_alloc
),
billing AS (
  SELECT
    b.`Sales Document Number`,
    b.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(b.`Billed Quantity`) AS billed_qty
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_billing_document_line_item` b
      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois
        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = b.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = b.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    b.`Billed Quantity` > 0
    AND b.`SD Document Category` = 'M'
  GROUP BY
    b.`Sales Document Number`,
    b.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
delivery_tbl AS (
  SELECT
    d.`Reference Document` AS `Sales Document Number`,
    d.`Reference Item` AS `Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(d.`Measure Actual Delivery Quantity`) AS delivered_qty
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_item` d
      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois
        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = d.`Reference Document`
        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = d.`Reference Item`
  WHERE
    d.`Goods Movement Status` = 'C'
  GROUP BY
    d.`Reference Document`,
    d.`Reference Item`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    a.cs_team,
    a.delivery_date,
    a.allocated_value,
    a.order_qty,
    a.line_qty,
    a.is_cm,
    a.order_status,
    COALESCE(b.billed_qty, 0) AS billed_qty,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(d.delivered_qty, 0), COALESCE(b.billed_qty, 0)) AS fulfilled_qty,
    SUM(a.line_qty) OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.`Sales Document Number`, a.`Sales Document Item Number`
        ORDER BY a.delivery_date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) AS cumul_qty
  FROM
    all_alloc a
      LEFT JOIN billing b
        ON b.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`
        AND b.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`
      LEFT JOIN delivery_tbl d
        ON d.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`
        AND d.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    cs_team,
    delivery_date,
    allocated_value,
    CASE
      WHEN
        line_qty > 0
      THEN
        allocated_value
          * LEAST(
            GREATEST(LEAST(billed_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
            1.0
          )
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN fulfilled_qty > 0 THEN allocated_value
          ELSE 0
        END
    END AS billed_value,
    CASE
      WHEN
        line_qty > 0
      THEN
        GREATEST(
          allocated_value
            * LEAST(
              GREATEST(LEAST(fulfilled_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
              1.0
            )
            - allocated_value
              * LEAST(
                GREATEST(LEAST(billed_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
                1.0
              ),
          0
        )
      ELSE 0
    END AS delivered_not_billed_value,
    CASE
      WHEN
        line_qty > 0
      THEN
        allocated_value
          * (
            1
              - LEAST(
                GREATEST(LEAST(fulfilled_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
                1.0
              )
          )
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN fulfilled_qty > 0 THEN 0
          ELSE allocated_value
        END
    END
      * CASE
        WHEN order_status = 'C' THEN 0
        ELSE 1
      END AS open_value
  FROM
    combined
  WHERE
    is_cm = 1
),
team_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cs_team,
    ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(billed_value, 0)), 0) AS billed_eur,
    ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(delivered_not_billed_value, 0)), 0) AS delivered_not_billed_eur,
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN delivery_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1) THEN GREATEST(open_value, 0)
          ELSE 0
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS open_past_due_eur,
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN delivery_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1) THEN GREATEST(open_value, 0)
          ELSE 0
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS open_not_yet_due_eur,
    ROUND(SUM(allocated_value), 0) AS total_eur
  FROM
    bucketed
  GROUP BY
    cs_team
),
working_days AS (
  SELECT
    SIZE(
      FILTER(
        SEQUENCE(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()), DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1), INTERVAL 1 DAY),
        d -> DAYOFWEEK(d) NOT IN (1, 7)
      )
    ) AS elapsed_wd,
    SIZE(
      FILTER(
        SEQUENCE(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()), LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY),
        d -> DAYOFWEEK(d) NOT IN (1, 7)
      )
    ) AS total_wd
)
SELECT
  cs_team,
  billed_eur,
  delivered_not_billed_eur,
  open_past_due_eur,
  open_not_yet_due_eur,
  total_eur,
  CASE
    WHEN total_eur > 0 THEN ROUND((billed_eur + delivered_not_billed_eur) / total_eur, 4)
    ELSE 0
  END AS billed_delivered_pct,
  ROUND(wd.elapsed_wd * 1.0 / wd.total_wd, 4) AS month_progress,
  CASE
    WHEN
      total_eur > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(
        (billed_eur + delivered_not_billed_eur) / total_eur - wd.elapsed_wd * 1.0 / wd.total_wd,
        4
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS run_rate_gap,
  CASE
    WHEN total_eur <= 0 THEN 'N/A'
    WHEN
      (billed_eur + delivered_not_billed_eur) / total_eur
        >= wd.elapsed_wd * 1.0 / wd.total_wd - 0.05
    THEN
      '🟢 On Track'
    WHEN
      (billed_eur + delivered_not_billed_eur) / total_eur
        >= wd.elapsed_wd * 1.0 / wd.total_wd - 0.25
    THEN
      '🟠 Behind'
    ELSE '🔴 Significantly Behind'
  END AS run_rate_status
FROM
  team_agg CROSS JOIN working_days wd
ORDER BY
  total_eur DESC

    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
  FROM
    all_alloc
),
billing AS (
  SELECT
    b.`Sales Document Number`,
    b.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(b.`Billed Quantity`) AS billed_qty
  FROM
    `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_fact_billing_document_line_item` b
      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois
        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = b.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = b.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    b.`Billed Quantity` > 0
    AND b.`SD Document Category` = 'M'
  GROUP BY
    b.`Sales Document Number`,
    b.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
delivery_tbl AS (
  SELECT
    d.`Reference Document` AS `Sales Document Number`,
    d.`Reference Item` AS `Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(d.`Measure Actual Delivery Quantity`) AS delivered_qty
  FROM
    `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_item` d
      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois
        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = d.`Reference Document`
        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = d.`Reference Item`
  WHERE
    d.`Goods Movement Status` = 'C'
  GROUP BY
    d.`Reference Document`,
    d.`Reference Item`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    a.cs_team,
    a.delivery_date,
    a.allocated_value,
    a.order_qty,
    a.line_qty,
    a.is_cm,
    a.order_status,
    COALESCE(b.billed_qty, 0) AS billed_qty,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(d.delivered_qty, 0), COALESCE(b.billed_qty, 0)) AS fulfilled_qty,
    SUM(a.line_qty) OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.`Sales Document Number`, a.`Sales Document Item Number`
        ORDER BY a.delivery_date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) AS cumul_qty
  FROM
    all_alloc a
      LEFT JOIN billing b
        ON b.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`
        AND b.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`
      LEFT JOIN delivery_tbl d
        ON d.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`
        AND d.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    cs_team,
    delivery_date,
    allocated_value,
    CASE
      WHEN
        line_qty > 0
      THEN
        allocated_value
          * LEAST(
            GREATEST(LEAST(billed_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
            1.0
          )
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN fulfilled_qty > 0 THEN allocated_value
          ELSE 0
        END
    END AS billed_value,
    CASE
      WHEN
        line_qty > 0
      THEN
        GREATEST(
          allocated_value
            * LEAST(
              GREATEST(LEAST(fulfilled_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
              1.0
            )
            - allocated_value
              * LEAST(
                GREATEST(LEAST(billed_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
                1.0
              ),
          0
        )
      ELSE 0
    END AS delivered_not_billed_value,
    CASE
      WHEN
        line_qty > 0
      THEN
        allocated_value
          * (
            1
              - LEAST(
                GREATEST(LEAST(fulfilled_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
                1.0
              )
          )
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN fulfilled_qty > 0 THEN 0
          ELSE allocated_value
        END
    END
      * CASE
        WHEN order_status = 'C' THEN 0
        ELSE 1
      END AS open_value
  FROM
    combined
  WHERE
    is_cm = 1
),
team_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cs_team,
    ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(billed_value, 0)), 0) AS billed_eur,
    ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(delivered_not_billed_value, 0)), 0) AS delivered_not_billed_eur,
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN delivery_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1) THEN GREATEST(open_value, 0)
          ELSE 0
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS open_past_due_eur,
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN delivery_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1) THEN GREATEST(open_value, 0)
          ELSE 0
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS open_not_yet_due_eur,
    ROUND(SUM(allocated_value), 0) AS total_eur
  FROM
    bucketed
  GROUP BY
    cs_team
),
working_days AS (
  SELECT
    SIZE(
      FILTER(
        SEQUENCE(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()), DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1), INTERVAL 1 DAY),
        d -> DAYOFWEEK(d) NOT IN (1, 7)
      )
    ) AS elapsed_wd,
    SIZE(
      FILTER(
        SEQUENCE(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()), LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY),
        d -> DAYOFWEEK(d) NOT IN (1, 7)
      )
    ) AS total_wd
)
SELECT
  cs_team,
  billed_eur,
  delivered_not_billed_eur,
  open_past_due_eur,
  open_not_yet_due_eur,
  total_eur,
  CASE
    WHEN total_eur > 0 THEN ROUND((billed_eur + delivered_not_billed_eur) / total_eur, 4)
    ELSE 0
  END AS billed_delivered_pct,
  ROUND(wd.elapsed_wd * 1.0 / wd.total_wd, 4) AS month_progress,
  CASE
    WHEN
      total_eur > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(
        (billed_eur + delivered_not_billed_eur) / total_eur - wd.elapsed_wd * 1.0 / wd.total_wd,
        4
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS run_rate_gap,
  CASE
    WHEN total_eur <= 0 THEN 'N/A'
    WHEN
      (billed_eur + delivered_not_billed_eur) / total_eur
        >= wd.elapsed_wd * 1.0 / wd.total_wd - 0.05
    THEN
      '🟢 On Track'
    WHEN
      (billed_eur + delivered_not_billed_eur) / total_eur
        >= wd.elapsed_wd * 1.0 / wd.total_wd - 0.25
    THEN
      '🟠 Behind'
    ELSE '🔴 Significantly Behind'
  END AS run_rate_status
FROM
  team_agg CROSS JOIN working_days wd
ORDER BY
  total_eur DESC

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(TO_DATE(CAST(`Created On` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')) AS max_date
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` item
      JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg
        ON sorg.`Sales Organization Key` = item.`Sales Organization Key`
  WHERE
    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'
    AND (
      item.`Sales Document Type Description` IN (
        'Standard Order', 'Rush Order', 'Consignment Issue'
      )
      OR item.`Sales Document Type` IN ('YOR', 'YSO', 'YKE', 'YKB')
    )
    AND item.`Created On` >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -30), 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(item.`Application area Description`, 'Unknown') AS segment,
  CASE
    WHEN ABS(item.`Measure Net Value in Euro`) < 500 THEN '<€500'
    WHEN ABS(item.`Measure Net Value in Euro`) < 1000 THEN '€500–€1K'
    WHEN ABS(item.`Measure Net Value in Euro`) < 2500 THEN '€1K–€2.5K'
    WHEN ABS(item.`Measure Net Value in Euro`) < 5000 THEN '€2.5K–€5K'
    WHEN ABS(item.`Measure Net Value in Euro`) < 25000 THEN '€5K–€25K'
    ELSE '>€25K'
  END AS value_bucket,
  CASE
    WHEN ABS(item.`Measure Net Value in Euro`) < 500 THEN 1
    WHEN ABS(item.`Measure Net Value in Euro`) < 1000 THEN 2
    WHEN ABS(item.`Measure Net Value in Euro`) < 2500 THEN 3
    WHEN ABS(item.`Measure Net Value in Euro`) < 5000 THEN 4
    WHEN ABS(item.`Measure Net Value in Euro`) < 25000 THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END AS bucket_order,
  COUNT(DISTINCT item.`Sales Document Number`) AS order_count
FROM
  `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` item
    JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg
      ON sorg.`Sales Organization Key` = item.`Sales Organization Key`
    CROSS JOIN last_day ld
WHERE
  sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'
  AND (
    item.`Rejection Status` != 'C'
    OR item.`Rejection Status` IS NULL

  AND (
    item.`Sales Document Type Description` IN ('Standard Order', 'Rush Order', 'Consignment Issue')
    OR item.`Sales Document Type` IN ('YOR', 'YSO', 'YKE', 'YKB')
  )
  AND TO_DATE(CAST(item.`Created On` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = ld.max_date
GROUP BY
  1,
  2,
  3
ORDER BY
  segment,
  bucket_order

WITH item_data AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        item.`Sales Document Type Description` LIKE '%Quotation%'
        OR item.`Sales Document Type` = 'YQT'
      THEN
        'Quotations'
      WHEN item.`Sales Document Type Description` = 'General complaint' THEN 'Complaints'
    END AS category,
    TO_DATE(CAST(item.`Created On` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS creation_date,
    item.`Sales Document Number`,
    item.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    ABS(item.`Measure Net Value in Euro`) AS value_eur
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` item
      JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg
        ON sorg.`Sales Organization Key` = item.`Sales Organization Key`
  WHERE
    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'
    AND item.`Created On` >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -30), 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)
    AND (
      item.`Sales Document Type Description` LIKE '%Quotation%'
      OR item.`Sales Document Type` = 'YQT'
      OR item.`Sales Document Type Description` = 'General complaint'
    )
),
last_dates AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    MAX(creation_date) AS last_date
  FROM
    item_data
  WHERE
    category IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    category
)
SELECT
  d.category,
  d.last_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.`Sales Document Number`) AS num_documents,
  COUNT(*) AS num_lines,
  ROUND(SUM(i.value_eur), 0) AS total_value_eur
FROM
  last_dates d
    JOIN item_data i
      ON i.category = d.category
      AND i.creation_date = d.last_date
GROUP BY
  d.category,
  d.last_date
ORDER BY
  d.category

WITH industry_orders AS (
  SELECT
    item.`Sales Document Number`,
    item.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    item.`Measure Net Value in Euro` AS order_value_eur,
    item.`Measure Sales Order Quantity` AS order_qty,
    item.`Delivery Date To Key`,
    item.`Customer Key`,
    item.`Material Key`,
    item.`Plant Key`,
    COALESCE(item.`Application area Description`, 'Unknown') AS segment,
    COALESCE(csm.`cs_team`, 'Unmapped') AS cs_team,
    CASE
      WHEN item.`Incoterms Description` LIKE '%Ex Works%' THEN 'EXW'
      WHEN item.`Incoterms Description` LIKE '%Free Carrier%' THEN 'FCA'
      WHEN item.`Incoterms Description` LIKE '%Free on Board%' THEN 'FOB'
      WHEN item.`Incoterms Description` LIKE '%Carriage paid to%' THEN 'CPT'
      WHEN item.`Incoterms Description` LIKE '%Carriage%Insurance%' THEN 'CIF'
      WHEN item.`Incoterms Description` LIKE '%Delivered at place%' THEN 'DAP'
      WHEN item.`Incoterms Description` LIKE '%Delivered Duty Paid%' THEN 'DDP'
      WHEN item.`Incoterms Description` LIKE '%Cost and Freight%' THEN 'CFR'
      WHEN item.`Incoterms Description` LIKE '%Delivered at Place Unloaded%' THEN 'DPU'
      WHEN item.`Incoterms Description` LIKE '%Free Alongside%' THEN 'FAS'
      ELSE item.`Incoterms Description`
    END AS incoterm,
    item.`Shipping Conditions Description` AS shipping_condition,
    item.`Created By` AS created_by,
    item.`Delivery Block` AS delivery_block,
    item.`Delivery Block Description` AS delivery_block_desc
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` item
      JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg
        ON sorg.`Sales Organization Key` = item.`Sales Organization Key`
      LEFT JOIN `supply_chain_sandbox_d`.`datamodel`.`cs_team_sales_org_mapping` csm
        ON sorg.`Sales_Organization ID` = csm.`sales_org_code`
  WHERE
    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'
    AND (
      item.`Rejection Status` != 'C'
      OR item.`Rejection Status` IS NULL
    )
    AND item.`Order Status` != 'C'
    AND (
      item.`Sales Document Type Description` IN (
        'Standard Order', 'Rush Order', 'Consignment Issue'
      )
      OR item.`Sales Document Type` IN ('YOR', 'YSO', 'YKE', 'YKB')
    )
    AND item.`Created On` >= 20260101
),
all_schedule_lines_raw AS (
  SELECT
    sl.`Sales Document Number`,
    sl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    sl.`Schedule Line Number` AS sl_no,
    TO_DATE(CAST(sl.`Goods Issue Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS gi_date,
    sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` AS confirmed_qty,
    sl.`Measure Order Quantity` AS sl_order_qty
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_schedule_line` sl
      INNER JOIN industry_orders io
        ON sl.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND sl.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    sl.`Goods Issue Date` >= 20260101
    AND (sl.`Measure Order Quantity` > 0 OR sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` > 0)
),
-- Dedup: drop old rescheduled confirmed lines (confirmed > 0, order = 0)
-- only when the same item has a confirmed line with order > 0
all_schedule_lines AS (
  SELECT `Sales Document Number`, `Sales Document Item Number`, sl_no,
    gi_date, confirmed_qty, sl_order_qty
  FROM (
    SELECT r.*,
      MAX(CASE WHEN r.confirmed_qty > 0 AND r.sl_order_qty > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (PARTITION BY r.`Sales Document Number`, r.`Sales Document Item Number`) AS has_oq_conf
    FROM all_schedule_lines_raw r
  )
  WHERE NOT (confirmed_qty > 0 AND sl_order_qty = 0 AND has_oq_conf = 1)
),
item_has_confirmed AS (
  SELECT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(confirmed_qty) AS total_confirmed_qty
  FROM
    all_schedule_lines
  WHERE
    confirmed_qty > 0
  GROUP BY
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
),
item_unconfirmed_total AS (
  SELECT
    asl.`Sales Document Number`,
    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(asl.sl_order_qty) AS total_unconfirmed_order_qty
  FROM
    all_schedule_lines asl
      LEFT JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc
        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    ihc.`Sales Document Number` IS NULL
    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0
    AND asl.confirmed_qty = 0
  GROUP BY
    asl.`Sales Document Number`,
    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
item_partial_unconfirmed AS (
  SELECT
    asl.`Sales Document Number`,
    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(asl.sl_order_qty) AS total_unconfirmed_order_qty
  FROM
    all_schedule_lines asl
      INNER JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc
        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
      INNER JOIN industry_orders io
        ON io.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`
        AND io.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    asl.sl_order_qty > 0
    AND asl.confirmed_qty = 0
    AND ihc.total_confirmed_qty < io.order_qty
    AND io.order_qty > 0
  GROUP BY
    asl.`Sales Document Number`,
    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
items_with_any_sl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
  FROM
    all_schedule_lines
),
date_dim AS (
  SELECT
    `Date Delivery Key`,
    `Date Delivery` AS dim_date
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_date_delivery`
),
rule1a AS (
  SELECT
    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    CASE
      WHEN ihc.total_confirmed_qty >= o.order_qty OR o.order_qty = 0
      THEN o.order_value_eur * (asl.confirmed_qty / ihc.total_confirmed_qty)
      ELSE o.order_value_eur * (asl.confirmed_qty / GREATEST(o.order_qty, ihc.total_confirmed_qty))
    END AS allocated_value,
    o.`Sales Document Number`,
    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    o.`Customer Key`,
    o.`Material Key`,
    o.`Plant Key`,
    o.segment,
    o.cs_team,
    o.incoterm,
    o.shipping_condition,
    o.created_by,
    o.delivery_block,
    o.delivery_block_desc,
    asl.confirmed_qty AS line_qty
  FROM
    industry_orders o
      JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc
        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN all_schedule_lines asl
        ON asl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND asl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    asl.confirmed_qty > 0
),
rule1b AS (
  SELECT
    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    o.order_value_eur * (asl.sl_order_qty / iut.total_unconfirmed_order_qty) AS allocated_value,
    o.`Sales Document Number`,
    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    o.`Customer Key`,
    o.`Material Key`,
    o.`Plant Key`,
    o.segment,
    o.cs_team,
    o.incoterm,
    o.shipping_condition,
    o.created_by,
    o.delivery_block,
    o.delivery_block_desc,
    asl.sl_order_qty AS line_qty
  FROM
    industry_orders o
      JOIN item_unconfirmed_total iut
        ON iut.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND iut.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN all_schedule_lines asl
        ON asl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND asl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    asl.confirmed_qty = 0
    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0
),
rule1b_partial AS (
  SELECT
    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    o.order_value_eur
      * (1.0 - LEAST(ihc.total_confirmed_qty / GREATEST(o.order_qty, 1), 1.0))
      * (asl.sl_order_qty / ipu.total_unconfirmed_order_qty) AS allocated_value,
    o.`Sales Document Number`,
    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    o.`Customer Key`,
    o.`Material Key`,
    o.`Plant Key`,
    o.segment,
    o.cs_team,
    o.incoterm,
    o.shipping_condition,
    o.created_by,
    o.delivery_block,

    io.`Plant Key`,
    io.cs_team,
    io.segment,
    io.order_qty AS line_qty,
    io.order_status
  FROM
    industry_orders io
      LEFT JOIN items_with_any_sl isl
        ON isl.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND isl.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN (
        SELECT
          `Date Delivery Key`,
          `Date Delivery` AS dim_date
        FROM
          `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_date_delivery`
      ) dd
        ON dd.`Date Delivery Key` = io.`Delivery Date To Key`
  WHERE
    isl.`Sales Document Number` IS NULL
    AND dd.dim_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())
),
all_alloc AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1a
  WHERE
    scope IN ('CM', 'YTD', 'FUT')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1b_partial
  WHERE
    scope IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1b_full
  WHERE
    scope IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule2
  WHERE
    scope IS NOT NULL
),
orders_in_scope AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
  FROM
    all_alloc
),
billing AS (
  SELECT
    b.`Sales Document Number`,
    b.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(b.`Billed Quantity`) AS billed_qty
  FROM
    `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_fact_billing_document_line_item` b
      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois
        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = b.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = b.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    b.`Billed Quantity` > 0
    AND b.`SD Document Category` = 'M'
  GROUP BY
    b.`Sales Document Number`,
    b.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
delivery_tbl AS (
  SELECT
    d.`Reference Document` AS `Sales Document Number`,
    d.`Reference Item` AS `Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(d.`Measure Actual Delivery Quantity`) AS delivered_qty
  FROM
    `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_item` d
      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois
        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = d.`Reference Document`
        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = d.`Reference Item`
  WHERE
    d.`Goods Movement Status` = 'C'
  GROUP BY
    d.`Reference Document`,
    d.`Reference Item`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    a.scope,
    a.cs_team,
    a.segment,
    a.`Plant Key`,
    a.delivery_date,
    a.allocated_value,
    a.line_qty,
    a.order_status,
    COALESCE(b.billed_qty, 0) AS billed_qty,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(d.delivered_qty, 0), COALESCE(b.billed_qty, 0)) AS fulfilled_qty,
    SUM(a.line_qty) OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.`Sales Document Number`, a.`Sales Document Item Number`
        ORDER BY a.delivery_date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) AS cumul_qty
  FROM
    all_alloc a
      LEFT JOIN billing b
        ON b.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`
        AND b.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`
      LEFT JOIN delivery_tbl d
        ON d.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`
        AND d.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    scope,
    cs_team,
    segment,
    `Plant Key`,
    delivery_date,
    allocated_value,
    CASE
      WHEN
        line_qty > 0
      THEN
        allocated_value
          * LEAST(
            GREATEST(LEAST(billed_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
            1.0
          )
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN fulfilled_qty > 0 THEN allocated_value
          ELSE 0
        END
    END AS billed_value,
    CASE
      WHEN
        line_qty > 0
      THEN
        GREATEST(
          allocated_value
            * LEAST(
              GREATEST(LEAST(fulfilled_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
              1.0
            )
            - allocated_value
              * LEAST(
                GREATEST(LEAST(billed_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
                1.0
              ),
          0
        )
      ELSE 0
    END AS delivered_not_billed_value,
    CASE
      WHEN
        line_qty > 0
      THEN
        allocated_value
          * (
            1
              - LEAST(
                GREATEST(LEAST(fulfilled_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
                1.0
              )
          )
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN fulfilled_qty > 0 THEN 0
          ELSE allocated_value
        END
    END
      * CASE
        WHEN order_status = 'C' THEN 0
        ELSE 1
      END AS open_value
  FROM
    combined
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    scope,
    cs_team,
    segment,
    `Plant Key`,
    ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(billed_value, 0)), 0) AS billed_eur,
    ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(delivered_not_billed_value, 0)), 0) AS delivered_not_billed_eur,
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN delivery_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1) THEN GREATEST(open_value, 0)
          ELSE 0
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS open_past_due_eur,
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN delivery_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1) THEN GREATEST(open_value, 0)
          ELSE 0
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS open_not_yet_due_eur,
    ROUND(SUM(allocated_value), 0) AS total_eur
  FROM
    bucketed
  GROUP BY
    scope,
    cs_team,
    segment,
    `Plant Key`
)
SELECT
  a.scope,
  a.cs_team,
  a.segment,
  COALESCE(p.`Plant Code & Text`, CAST(a.`Plant Key` AS STRING)) AS plant,
  b.bucket,
  b.value_eur
FROM
  agg a
    LEFT JOIN `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_dim_plant` p
      ON p.`Plant Key` = a.`Plant Key`
  LATERAL VIEW
    STACK(
      4,
      'Billed',
      a.billed_eur,
      'Delivered (not billed)',
      a.delivered_not_billed_eur,
      'Open Past Due',
      a.open_past_due_eur,
      'Open Not Yet Due',
      a.open_not_yet_due_eur
    ) b
    AS bucket, value_eur

WITH industry_orders AS (

      LEFT JOIN `supply_chain_sandbox_d`.`datamodel`.`cs_team_sales_org_mapping` csm
        ON sorg.`Sales_Organization ID` = csm.`sales_org_code`
  WHERE
    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'
    AND (
      item.`Rejection Status` != 'C'
      OR item.`Rejection Status` IS NULL
    )
    AND item.`Order Status` != 'C'
    AND (
      item.`Sales Document Type Description` IN (
        'Standard Order', 'Rush Order', 'Consignment Issue'
      )
      OR item.`Sales Document Type` IN ('YOR', 'YSO', 'YKE', 'YKB')
    )
    AND item.`Created On` >= 20260101
),
-- Pass 1: YTD+ schedule lines only
ytd_future_schedule_lines_raw AS (
  SELECT
    sl.`Sales Document Number`,
    sl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    TO_DATE(CAST(sl.`Goods Issue Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS gi_date,
    sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` AS confirmed_qty,
    sl.`Measure Order Quantity` AS sl_order_qty
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_schedule_line` sl
      INNER JOIN industry_orders io
        ON sl.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`
        AND sl.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    sl.`Goods Issue Date`
      >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE()), 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)
    AND (sl.`Measure Order Quantity` > 0 OR sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` > 0)
),
ytd_future_schedule_lines AS (
  SELECT `Sales Document Number`, `Sales Document Item Number`,
    gi_date, confirmed_qty, sl_order_qty
  FROM (
    SELECT r.*,
      MAX(CASE WHEN r.confirmed_qty > 0 AND r.sl_order_qty > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (PARTITION BY r.`Sales Document Number`, r.`Sales Document Item Number`) AS has_oq_conf
    FROM ytd_future_schedule_lines_raw r
  )
  WHERE NOT (confirmed_qty > 0 AND sl_order_qty = 0 AND has_oq_conf = 1)
),
confirmed_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
  FROM
    ytd_future_schedule_lines
  WHERE
    confirmed_qty > 0
),
-- Pass 2: Full history only for confirmed items
history_schedule_lines_raw AS (
  SELECT
    sl.`Sales Document Number`,
    sl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    TO_DATE(CAST(sl.`Goods Issue Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS gi_date,
    sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` AS confirmed_qty,
    sl.`Measure Order Quantity` AS sl_oq
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_schedule_line` sl
      INNER JOIN confirmed_items ci
        ON sl.`Sales Document Number` = ci.`Sales Document Number`
        AND sl.`Sales Document Item Number` = ci.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    sl.`Goods Issue Date` >= 20260101
    AND sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` > 0
),
history_schedule_lines AS (
  SELECT `Sales Document Number`, `Sales Document Item Number`, gi_date, confirmed_qty
  FROM (
    SELECT r.*,
      MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl_oq > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (PARTITION BY r.`Sales Document Number`, r.`Sales Document Item Number`) AS has_oq
    FROM history_schedule_lines_raw r
  )
  WHERE sl_oq > 0 OR has_oq = 0
),
item_has_confirmed AS (
  SELECT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(confirmed_qty) AS total_confirmed_qty
  FROM
    history_schedule_lines
  GROUP BY
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
),
item_unconfirmed_total AS (
  SELECT
    asl.`Sales Document Number`,
    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(asl.sl_order_qty) AS total_unconfirmed_order_qty
  FROM
    ytd_future_schedule_lines asl
      LEFT JOIN confirmed_items ci
        ON ci.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ci.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    ci.`Sales Document Number` IS NULL
    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0
    AND asl.confirmed_qty = 0
  GROUP BY
    asl.`Sales Document Number`,
    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
item_partial_unconfirmed AS (
  SELECT
    asl.`Sales Document Number`,
    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(asl.sl_order_qty) AS total_unconfirmed_order_qty
  FROM
    ytd_future_schedule_lines asl
      INNER JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc
        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
      INNER JOIN industry_orders io
        ON io.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`
        AND io.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    asl.sl_order_qty > 0
    AND asl.confirmed_qty = 0
    AND ihc.total_confirmed_qty < io.order_qty
    AND io.order_qty > 0
  GROUP BY
    asl.`Sales Document Number`,
    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
items_with_any_sl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
  FROM
    ytd_future_schedule_lines
),
date_dim AS (
  SELECT
    `Date Delivery Key`,
    `Date Delivery` AS dim_date
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_date_delivery`
),
rule1a AS (
  SELECT
    hsl.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    CASE
      WHEN ihc.total_confirmed_qty >= o.order_qty OR o.order_qty = 0
      THEN o.order_value_eur * (hsl.confirmed_qty / ihc.total_confirmed_qty)
      ELSE o.order_value_eur * (hsl.confirmed_qty / GREATEST(o.order_qty, ihc.total_confirmed_qty))
    END AS allocated_value,
    o.`Sales Document Number`,
    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    o.`Customer Key`,
    o.`Material Key`,
    o.cs_team,
    o.delivery_block,
    o.delivery_block_desc,
    hsl.confirmed_qty AS line_qty,
    o.order_qty
  FROM
    industry_orders o
      JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc
        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN history_schedule_lines hsl
        ON hsl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND hsl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    hsl.gi_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())
),
rule1b AS (
  SELECT
    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    o.order_value_eur * (asl.sl_order_qty / iut.total_unconfirmed_order_qty) AS allocated_value,
    o.`Sales Document Number`,
    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    o.`Customer Key`,
    o.`Material Key`,
    o.cs_team,
    o.delivery_block,
    o.delivery_block_desc,
    asl.sl_order_qty AS line_qty,
    o.order_qty
  FROM
    industry_orders o
      JOIN item_unconfirmed_total iut
        ON iut.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND iut.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN ytd_future_schedule_lines asl
        ON asl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND asl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    asl.confirmed_qty = 0
    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0
),
rule1b_partial AS (
  SELECT
    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    o.order_value_eur
      * (1.0 - LEAST(ihc.total_confirmed_qty / GREATEST(o.order_qty, 1), 1.0))
      * (asl.sl_order_qty / ipu.total_unconfirmed_order_qty) AS allocated_value,
    o.`Sales Document Number`,
    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    o.`Customer Key`,
    o.`Material Key`,
    o.cs_team,
    o.delivery_block,
    o.delivery_block_desc,
    asl.sl_order_qty AS line_qty,
    o.order_qty
  FROM
    industry_orders o
      JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc
        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN item_partial_unconfirmed ipu
        ON ipu.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ipu.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN ytd_future_schedule_lines asl
        ON asl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND asl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    asl.confirmed_qty = 0
    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0
),
rule2 AS (
  SELECT
    dd.dim_date AS delivery_date,
    o.order_value_eur AS allocated_value,
    o.`Sales Document Number`,
    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    o.`Customer Key`,
    o.`Material Key`,
    o.cs_team,
    o.delivery_block,
    o.delivery_block_desc,
    o.order_qty AS line_qty,
    o.order_qty
  FROM
    industry_orders o
      LEFT JOIN items_with_any_sl isl
        ON isl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND isl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN date_dim dd
        ON dd.`Date Delivery Key` = o.`Delivery Date To Key`
  WHERE
    isl.`Sales Document Number` IS NULL
    AND dd.dim_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())
),
all_alloc AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1b_partial
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule2
),
orders_in_scope AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
  FROM
    all_alloc
),
billing AS (
  SELECT
    b.`Sales Document Number`,
    b.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(b.`Billed Quantity`) AS billed_qty
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_billing_document_line_item` b
      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois
        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = b.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = b.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    b.`Billed Quantity` > 0
    AND b.`SD Document Category` = 'M'
  GROUP BY
    b.`Sales Document Number`,
    b.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
delivery_tbl AS (
  SELECT
    d.`Reference Document` AS `Sales Document Number`,
    d.`Reference Item` AS `Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(d.`Measure Actual Delivery Quantity`) AS delivered_qty
  FROM
    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_item` d
      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois
        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = d.`Reference Document`
        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = d.`Reference Item`
  WHERE
    d.`Goods Movement Status` = 'C'
  GROUP BY
    d.`Reference Document`,
    d.`Reference Item`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    a.delivery_date,
    a.allocated_value,
    a.`Sales Document Number`,
    a.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    a.`Customer Key`,
    a.`Material Key`,
    a.cs_team,
    a.delivery_block,
    a.delivery_block_desc,
    a.line_qty,
    a.order_qty,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(d.delivered_qty, 0), COALESCE(b.billed_qty, 0)) AS fulfilled_qty,
    SUM(a.line_qty) OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.`Sales Document Number`, a.`Sales Document Item Number`
        ORDER BY a.delivery_date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) AS cumul_qty
  FROM
    all_alloc a
      LEFT JOIN billing b
        ON b.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`
        AND b.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`
      LEFT JOIN delivery_tbl d
        ON d.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`
        AND d.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
with_open AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN fulfilled_qty >= order_qty AND order_qty > 0 THEN 0
      WHEN
        line_qty > 0
      THEN
        allocated_value
          * (
            1
              - LEAST(
                GREATEST(LEAST(fulfilled_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
                1.0
              )
          )
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN fulfilled_qty > 0 THEN 0
          ELSE allocated_value
        END
    END AS open_value_eur,
    CASE
      WHEN
        delivery_date BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE())
      THEN
        'CM'
      WHEN
        delivery_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())
        AND delivery_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE())
      THEN
        'YTD'
    END AS scope
  FROM
    combined
),
past_due AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    with_open
  WHERE
    open_value_eur > 0
    AND delivery_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1)
    AND scope IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_cm AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY open_value_eur DESC) AS rn
  FROM
    past_due
  WHERE
    scope = 'CM'
),
ranked_ytd AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY open_value_eur DESC) AS rn
  FROM
    past_due
  WHERE
    scope = 'YTD'
)
SELECT
  'Current Month' AS period,
  o.`Sales Document Number` AS order_number,
  COALESCE(c.`Customer & Text`, CAST(o.`Customer Key` AS STRING)) AS customer,
  COALESCE(m.`Material Text`, CAST(o.`Material Key` AS STRING)) AS material,
  o.delivery_date AS planned_gi_date,
  o.cs_team,
  ROUND(o.open_value_eur, 0) AS open_value_eur,
  CASE WHEN o.delivery_block IS NOT NULL AND o.delivery_block != '' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS delivery_blocked,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(o.delivery_block_desc, ''), '-') AS delivery_block_reason
FROM
  ranked_cm o
    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_customer` c
      ON c.`Customer Key` = o.`Customer Key`
    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_material` m
      ON m.`Material Key` = o.`Material Key`
WHERE
  o.rn <= 10
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'YTD Prior' AS period,
  o.`Sales Document Number` AS order_number,
  COALESCE(c.`Customer & Text`, CAST(o.`Customer Key` AS STRING)) AS customer,
  COALESCE(m.`Material Text`, CAST(o.`Material Key` AS STRING)) AS material,
  o.delivery_date AS planned_gi_date,
  o.cs_team,
  ROUND(o.open_value_eur, 0) AS open_value_eur,
  CASE WHEN o.delivery_block IS NOT NULL AND o.delivery_block != '' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS delivery_blocked,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(o.delivery_block_desc, ''), '-') AS delivery_block_reason
FROM
  ranked_ytd o
    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_customer` c
      ON c.`Customer Key` = o.`Customer Key`
    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_material` m
      ON m.`Material Key` = o.`Material Key`
WHERE
  o.rn <= 5
ORDER BY
  period,
  open_value_eur DESC

    )

),
-- Pass 1: YTD+ schedule lines only
ytd_future_schedule_lines_raw AS (
  SELECT
    sl.`Sales Document Number`,
    sl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    TO_DATE(CAST(sl.`Goods Issue Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS gi_date,
    sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` AS confirmed_qty,

  FROM
    `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_schedule_line` sl
      INNER JOIN industry_orders io
        ON sl.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`

    sl.`Goods Issue Date`

    AND (sl.`Measure Order Quantity` > 0 OR sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` > 0)
),
ytd_future_schedule_lines AS (
  SELECT `Sales Document Number`, `Sales Document Item Number`,
    gi_date, confirmed_qty, sl_order_qty
  FROM (
    SELECT r.*,
      MAX(CASE WHEN r.confirmed_qty > 0 AND r.sl_order_qty > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (PARTITION BY r.`Sales Document Number`, r.`Sales Document Item Number`) AS has_oq_conf
    FROM ytd_future_schedule_lines_raw r

),
confirmed_items AS (

    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`

-- Pass 2: Full history only for confirmed items
history_schedule_lines_raw AS (

    sl.`Sales Document Number`,
    sl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    TO_DATE(CAST(sl.`Goods Issue Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS gi_date,

    `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_schedule_line` sl
      INNER JOIN confirmed_items ci

    AND sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` > 0
),
history_schedule_lines AS (
  SELECT `Sales Document Number`, `Sales Document Item Number`, gi_date, confirmed_qty
  FROM (
    SELECT r.*,
      MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl_oq > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (PARTITION BY r.`Sales Document Number`, r.`Sales Document Item Number`) AS has_oq
    FROM history_schedule_lines_raw r

),
item_has_confirmed AS (
  SELECT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(confirmed_qty) AS total_confirmed_qty
  FROM
    history_schedule_lines
  GROUP BY
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
),
item_unconfirmed_total AS (
  SELECT
    asl.`Sales Document Number`,
    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(asl.sl_order_qty) AS total_unconfirmed_order_qty
  FROM
    ytd_future_schedule_lines asl
      LEFT JOIN confirmed_items ci

        AND ci.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE

    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0
    AND asl.confirmed_qty = 0
  GROUP BY

    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
item_partial_unconfirmed AS (
  SELECT
    asl.`Sales Document Number`,
    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    SUM(asl.sl_order_qty) AS total_unconfirmed_order_qty
  FROM
    ytd_future_schedule_lines asl
      INNER JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc
        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
      INNER JOIN industry_orders io
        ON io.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`
        AND io.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    asl.sl_order_qty > 0

    AND io.order_qty > 0
  GROUP BY

    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
items_with_any_sl AS (

    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
  FROM

date_dim AS (
  SELECT
    `Date Delivery Key`,
    `Date Delivery` AS dim_date
  FROM
    `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_date_delivery`
),
rule1a AS (
  SELECT
    hsl.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    CASE
      WHEN ihc.total_confirmed_qty >= o.order_qty OR o.order_qty = 0
      THEN o.order_value_eur * (hsl.confirmed_qty / ihc.total_confirmed_qty)
      ELSE o.order_value_eur * (hsl.confirmed_qty / GREATEST(o.order_qty, ihc.total_confirmed_qty))
    END AS allocated_value,
    o.`Sales Document Number`,
    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    o.`Customer Key`,
    o.`Material Key`,
    o.cs_team,
    o.delivery_block,
    o.delivery_block_desc,

  FROM

        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN history_schedule_lines hsl
        ON hsl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND hsl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    hsl.gi_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())
),
rule1b AS (
  SELECT
    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    o.order_value_eur * (asl.sl_order_qty / iut.total_unconfirmed_order_qty) AS allocated_value,
    o.`Sales Document Number`,
    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    o.`Customer Key`,
    o.`Material Key`,
    o.cs_team,
    o.delivery_block,
    o.delivery_block_desc,
    asl.sl_order_qty AS line_qty,
    o.order_qty
  FROM

      JOIN item_unconfirmed_total iut
        ON iut.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND iut.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN ytd_future_schedule_lines asl

        AND asl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    asl.confirmed_qty = 0
    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0
),
rule1b_partial AS (
  SELECT
    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,
    o.order_value_eur
      * (1.0 - LEAST(ihc.total_confirmed_qty / GREATEST(o.order_qty, 1), 1.0))
      * (asl.sl_order_qty / ipu.total_unconfirmed_order_qty) AS allocated_value,
    o.`Sales Document Number`,
    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    o.`Customer Key`,
    o.`Material Key`,
    o.cs_team,
    o.delivery_block,
    o.delivery_block_desc,

        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN item_partial_unconfirmed ipu
        ON ipu.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND ipu.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
      JOIN ytd_future_schedule_lines asl
        ON asl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`
        AND asl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`
  WHERE
    asl.confirmed_qty = 0
    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0

rule2 AS (
  SELECT
    dd.dim_date AS delivery_date,
    o.order_value_eur AS allocated_value,
    o.`Sales Document Number`,
    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    o.`Customer Key`,
    o.`Material Key`,
    o.cs_team,
    o.delivery_block,
    o.delivery_block_desc,
    o.order_qty AS line_qty,
    o.order_qty
  FROM
    industry_orders o

        AND isl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`

  WHERE
    isl.`Sales Document Number` IS NULL
    AND dd.dim_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())

all_alloc AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule1b_partial
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    rule2

orders_in_scope AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `Sales Document Number`,
    `Sales Document Item Number`
  FROM
    all_alloc

billing AS (

    b.`Sales Document Number`,

  WHERE

  SELECT

  FROM
    `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_item` d
      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois
        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = d.`Reference Document`
        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = d.`Reference Item`
  WHERE
    d.`Goods Movement Status` = 'C'
  GROUP BY
    d.`Reference Document`,
    d.`Reference Item`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    a.delivery_date,
    a.allocated_value,
    a.`Sales Document Number`,
    a.`Sales Document Item Number`,
    a.`Customer Key`,
    a.`Material Key`,
    a.cs_team,
    a.delivery_block,
    a.delivery_block_desc,
    a.line_qty,
    a.order_qty,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(d.delivered_qty, 0), COALESCE(b.billed_qty, 0)) AS fulfilled_qty,
    SUM(a.line_qty) OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.`Sales Document Number`, a.`Sales Document Item Number`
        ORDER BY a.delivery_date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) AS cumul_qty
  FROM
    all_alloc a
      LEFT JOIN billing b
        ON b.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`
        AND b.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`
      LEFT JOIN delivery_tbl d
        ON d.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`
        AND d.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`
),
with_open AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN fulfilled_qty >= order_qty AND order_qty > 0 THEN 0
      WHEN
        line_qty > 0
      THEN
        allocated_value
          * (
            1
              - LEAST(
                GREATEST(LEAST(fulfilled_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,
                1.0
              )
          )
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN fulfilled_qty > 0 THEN 0
          ELSE allocated_value
        END
    END AS open_value_eur,
    CASE
      WHEN
        delivery_date BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE())
      THEN
        'CM'
      WHEN
        delivery_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())
        AND delivery_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE())
      THEN
        'YTD'
    END AS scope
  FROM
    combined
),
past_due AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    with_open
  WHERE
    open_value_eur > 0
    AND delivery_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1)
    AND scope IS NOT NULL

ranked_cm AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY open_value_eur DESC) AS rn
  FROM
    past_due
  WHERE
    scope = 'CM'
),
ranked_ytd AS (
  SELECT

  FROM
    past_due
  WHERE
    scope = 'YTD'

    MAX(i.`Order Reason`) AS order_reason

    `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` i
      INNER JOIN `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg
        ON i.`Sales Organization Key` = sorg.`Sales Organization Key`
      LEFT JOIN `${var.source_catalog}`.pbi.`dbx_dim_customer` c
